bio.en: Tianci Gu is a PhD student in Natural Resources at the Faculty of Geographical Science, Beijing Normal University. Born in 1999, he is from Juye, Shandong, and is a member of the Communist Party of China. His research focuses on the local and distant ecological effects of urbanization and biodiversity conservation.

homeBio.en: Tianci Gu is a PhD student in Natural Resources at the Faculty of Geographical Science, Beijing Normal University. Born in 1999, he is from Juye, Shandong, and is a member of the Communist Party of China. His research focuses on the local and distant ecological effects of urbanization and biodiversity conservation.

homeBio.zh: 谷歌学术总引用1169次，h指数20。已发表第一或共同第一作者论文4篇、通讯或共同通讯作者论文7篇。另以第二作者参与5篇论文，均由导师担任第一作者，其中4篇已发表、1篇已录用。据个人简历材料，4篇成果入选ESI高被引论文。成果发表于npj Urban Sustainability、Earth’s Future等期刊。
homeBio.en: His Google Scholar profile records 1,169 citations and an h-index of 20. He is first or co-first author of four published papers and corresponding or co-corresponding author of seven. He is also second author of five papers with his supervisor as first author: four published articles and one accepted article. His CV lists four ESI Highly Cited Papers. His work has appeared in npj Urban Sustainability, Earth’s Future and other journals.

homeBio.zh: 主持校级课题3项和横向项目1项，参与科研项目11项，涵盖国家重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金、省部级及地方政府委托项目。曾获国家级及校院级奖励。两项政策建议被九三学社中央采用，并获湖北省委批示。
homeBio.en: He has led three university-funded research projects and one commissioned project, and participated in 11 additional projects supported by the National Key R&D Program of China, the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC), provincial or ministerial programs, or local governments. He has received national, university and faculty honors. Two policy recommendations were adopted by the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society and received written comments from the Hubei Provincial Party leadership.

homeBio.zh: 其研究主线连接城市化过程、生境影响路径与生物多样性响应，重点考察城市化如何通过三类路径改变生境质量并影响生物多样性。城市建设会直接改变生境；道路和污染向周边扩散，产生近程间接影响；消费与贸易通过供应链，将远程间接影响传导至生产地。
homeBio.en: His research connects urbanization processes, pathways of habitat change and biodiversity responses. It examines direct impacts of urban construction, indirect impacts on surrounding areas as roads and pollution spread, and distant indirect impacts transmitted through consumption, trade and supply chains to production regions.

homeBio.zh: 后续研究将从城市建设的直接影响入手，通过同等人口、不同空间形态的反事实比较，评估紧凑城市的节地与生态保护潜力。在此基础上，将直接、近程间接与远程间接影响纳入统一框架，量化各类路径的贡献及叠加效应，识别关键区域，探索城内、周边与远端生产地的协同治理，服务新型城镇化、生物多样性保护与美丽中国建设。
homeBio.en: His future research will compare counterfactual scenarios with the same population but different urban forms to assess the land-sparing and conservation potential of compact cities. It will then integrate direct impacts, indirect impacts on surrounding areas and distant indirect impacts into a common framework, quantify their contributions and combined effects, and identify key regions. The aim is to explore coordinated governance within cities, their surroundings and distant production regions, supporting new-type urbanization, biodiversity conservation and the Beautiful China initiative.

researchStatement.zh: 其研究主线连接城市化过程、生境影响路径与生物多样性响应，重点考察城市化如何通过三类路径改变生境质量并影响生物多样性。城市建设会直接改变生境；道路和污染向周边扩散，产生近程间接影响；消费与贸易通过供应链，将远程间接影响传导至生产地。
researchStatement.en: His research connects urbanization processes, pathways of habitat change and biodiversity responses. It examines direct impacts of urban construction, indirect impacts on surrounding areas as roads and pollution spread, and distant indirect impacts transmitted through consumption, trade and supply chains to production regions.

researchStatement.zh: 后续研究将从城市建设的直接影响入手，通过同等人口、不同空间形态的反事实比较，评估紧凑城市的节地与生态保护潜力。在此基础上，将直接、近程间接与远程间接影响纳入统一框架，量化各类路径的贡献及叠加效应，识别关键区域，探索城内、周边与远端生产地的协同治理，服务新型城镇化、生物多样性保护与美丽中国建设。
researchStatement.en: His future research will compare counterfactual scenarios with the same population but different urban forms to assess the land-sparing and conservation potential of compact cities. It will then integrate direct impacts, indirect impacts on surrounding areas and distant indirect impacts into a common framework, quantify their contributions and combined effects, and identify key regions. The aim is to explore coordinated governance within cities, their surroundings and distant production regions, supporting new-type urbanization, biodiversity conservation and the Beautiful China initiative.
